Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — scheduling & ops prep

Hi Sara (and Summit Retail team),

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood Inference — we’re excited to support your MAP and help make the evaluation + close timeline predictable. I want to get a short kickoff on the calendar to align stakeholders, confirm success criteria for the evaluation, and lock the timeline for the pilot.

Proposed agenda (60 minutes):
- Introductions & roles (10m)
- Evaluation scope & acceptance criteria (15m)
- Data access / security checklist and next steps (15m)
- Timeline & milestone ownership (10m)
- Action items and immediate next steps (10m)

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Wed, Sep 16 — 10:00–11:00
- Thu, Sep 17 — 09:00–10:00
- Fri, Sep 18 — 11:00–12:00

Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=mapKickoff
Calendar hold: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Attachments: MAP_kickoff_agenda_draft.pdf (one-page agenda draft) and a roles/contact matrix (MAP_roles_contact_matrix.xlsx).

Please reply with the best slot and the names/emails of the Summit stakeholders who should be present (we typically ask for: Executive sponsor, Product/PO, Engineering lead, Data owner, Security/IT). Laurel and Marcus from my team are cc'd — Laurel will run the ops and Marcus will own the evaluation plan details.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: MAP_kickoff_agenda_draft.pdf]
